views.definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.customer_id,
    u.full_name AS customer_name,
    c.issue_description,
    c.status,
    c.submitted_at,
    c.updated_at,
    rp.serial_number,
    pm.model_name,
    m.name AS manufacturer_name,
    w.start_date,
    w.end_date,
    w.is_void,
    ((((c.submitted_at)::date >= w.start_date) AND ((c.submitted_at)::date <= w.end_date)) AND (NOT w.is_void)) AS within_warranty_period,
    ca.officer_id,
    off.full_name AS assigned_officer,
    d.verdict,
    d.reason AS decision_reason,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM claim_evidence ev
          WHERE (ev.claim_id = c.id)) AS evidence_count
   FROM ((((((((warranty_claims c
     JOIN app_users u ON ((u.id = c.customer_id)))
     JOIN warranties w ON ((w.id = c.warranty_id)))
     JOIN registered_products rp ON ((rp.id = w.product_id)))
     JOIN product_models pm ON ((pm.id = rp.model_id)))
     JOIN manufacturers m ON ((m.id = pm.manufacturer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN claim_assignments ca ON ((ca.claim_id = c.id)))
     LEFT JOIN app_users off ON ((off.id = ca.officer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN claim_decisions d ON ((d.claim_id = c.id)));

SELECT status,
    (count(*))::integer AS total,
    (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (submitted_at >= (now() - '30 days'::interval))))::integer AS submitted_last_30_days
   FROM warranty_claims
  GROUP BY status;

SELECT p.id,
    p.title,
    p.version,
    m.name AS manufacturer_name,
    (count(DISTINCT doc.id))::integer AS document_count,
    (count(ch.id))::integer AS chunk_count
   FROM (((warranty_policies p
     JOIN manufacturers m ON ((m.id = p.manufacturer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN policy_documents doc ON ((doc.policy_id = p.id)))
     LEFT JOIN document_chunks ch ON ((ch.document_id = doc.id)))
  GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.version, m.name;

functionDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_new_claim()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO audit_events(event_type,entity_id,actor_id,details)
 VALUES('claim_submitted',NEW.id,NEW.customer_id,jsonb_build_object('warranty_id',NEW.warranty_id));
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_model_manufacturer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.manufacturer_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.manufacturer_id
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM registered_products WHERE model_id=OLD.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Registered model manufacturer is immutable';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_policy_terms()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.manufacturer_id,NEW.coverage_months,NEW.effective_from,NEW.version)
    IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.manufacturer_id,OLD.coverage_months,OLD.effective_from,OLD.version)
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM warranties WHERE policy_id=OLD.id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM policy_documents WHERE policy_id=OLD.id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Referenced policy terms are immutable; create a new version';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preserve_registered_product()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.id,NEW.customer_id,NEW.model_id,NEW.serial_number,NEW.purchased_on,NEW.registered_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM
    (OLD.id,OLD.customer_id,OLD.model_id,OLD.serial_number,OLD.purchased_on,OLD.registered_at)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM warranties WHERE product_id=OLD.id) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Warranted product facts are immutable';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_semantic_match_scope()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM warranty_claims c
  JOIN warranties w ON w.id = c.warranty_id
  JOIN policy_documents d ON d.policy_id = w.policy_id
  JOIN document_chunks ch ON ch.document_id = d.id
  WHERE c.id = NEW.claim_id AND ch.id = NEW.chunk_id
 ) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Semantic match must reference a chunk from the claim policy';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
